reasoning.summary: No defensible numeric patches yet. Current parameter values and management semantics were not supplied, so an absolute replacement cannot be established as a small, conservative change. Official checks corroborate the supplied BLS headline figures, October 7, 2026 FOMC-minutes release, and October 7 real yield of 2.92%, but these do not establish an M15 ATR-management effect. ([bls.gov](https://www.bls.gov/bls/)) From the supplied diagnostics, pvt102 warrants investigation: 66.67% signal win rate coexists with -1430.35 net pips and -1.919R; wider average losing risk is descriptive, not causal evidence for lowering maxRiskATR. snd107's +41.87 net pips but -2.458R is not demonstrated success. pattern132 is negative in both measures; its diagnostics do not identify a defensible parameter adjustment. Preserve pvtchart101's KEEP_CURRENT state. For 105, 103 and owl101, 100% quick-stop rates involve only two losses each; do not widen buffers from those samples. Identical 105/103 results require an overlap check before treating them as independent evidence. fund104, gf-study and the zero-signal indicators need more data. Obtain current allowed-key settings, parameter semantics, timestamped
